title: German-Style Chicken Tagine with Aerated Batter
description: A twist on traditional German cuisine, this recipe combines the flavors of tagine with the crispiness of an aerated batter.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together aerated flour, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add in water, whisking until smooth.
Add in tagine spice and whisk until combined.
Dredge chicken breast in the batter, making sure it's fully coated.
Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, sauté the onion and garlic in a separate skillet over medium heat until softened.
Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken with the sautéed onion and garlic, and garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
